verdict.rationale: Portkey documents its own cost tracking: a 'manage and attribute costs' page promises granular cost tracking, real-time metrics include cost optimization, and all requests across providers flow through one gateway and logs view. Per-key budgets show spend is metered at the API-key level, but the evidence never explicitly documents spend breakdowns by model, team, or user. Missing for 10: explicit per-model/team/user spend attribution and dashboards, documentation of cost analytics depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can track spend per model, key, team, or user across all providers in one place

citations.quote: Set up granular cost tracking, intelligent caching, and smart routing to cut infrastructure spends without touching your application logic.
Track 40+ crucial metrics in real time. Optimize costs, monitor quality, and reduce latency for peak performance.
A single pane to view and manage every AI provider and model in your organization. It provides centralized governance, discovery, and usage controls for all your AI resources.
Budget limits allow you to set maximum LLM spending or token usage thresholds on your API keys, automatically preventing further usage when limits are reached.
